acceptedAnswer.text: Anicca is an iPhone affirmation app with short cards for difficult days. Choose the areas you want support with to get started.
Choose the topics you want support with, then allow notifications on your iPhone to receive cards. You can manage notification permission in iPhone Settings.
Anicca is a Pāli word for impermanence: things change. It is the idea behind the app's gentle tone.
Anicca is free to download with optional in-app subscriptions. Available plans, local prices, and renewal terms are shown on the purchase screen.
Anicca requires iOS 16.6 or later. Check the App Store listing for current compatibility.

mainEntity.name: Where can I read about privacy?

acceptedAnswer.text: The Privacy Policy is linked from the App Store listing. Read it for details about how your data is handled.
